newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan approves Japan OTE commodity contracts.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan approves Japan OTE commodity contracts.

text.p: Taiwan's Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has granted approval to local brokerages to trade Osaka Textile Exchange's commodity futures contracts, a commission official said on Thurday.

The move, approved on Wednesday and effective immediately, allows registered Taiwanese futures brokers to trade on the Osaka Textile Exchange, mainly on cotton and wool futures contracts, the official said by telephone.
Taiwan allows futures trading only in government approved financial products and commodities.
Taiwan is aiming to open the island's own futures exchange by July 1, 1997 but still faces a key obstacle - lack of a futures exchange law to govern trading.
A draft law has been passed in a Legislative Yuan committee but the full parliament has yet to adopt final legislation.
The parliament may not pass the bill soon as the current session is only days away from a year-end recess.
